title: Persepolis Fortification Tablets (Elamite), Hallock PF 1–2087 / Персепольские таблички крепостной стены
author: Achaemenid administrators under Darius I
size: Over 15,000 records, c. 5% published; Hallock: 2,087 texts
edition: Hallock, OIP 92 (1969; free PDF, archive.org/details/oip92); OCHRE database.
ru_evidence: CyberLeninka 'Персеполь таблички эламские' gives only studies; no Russian translation found.
en_evidence: Hallock translated the 2,087 published texts; about 95% of the archive is unpublished (en.wikipedia).
value: Primary evidence for the Persian court, roads, rations and Greeks (Yaunā) in Persian service. Indispensable control for Herodotus, Xenophon and Ctesias.
ai_feasibility: medium: highly formulaic with a small vocabulary, but LLMs know little Elamite, so rely on Hallock's glossary. Unpublished tablets are not accessible.
pilot_unit: One Hallock category, e.g. Q texts (travel rations), a few hundred short texts
